review_policy: Review changed behavior against all GitHub Actions workflow scripts, all Dart and Python QA test files, and the original tests' protected security assertions; never edit tests merely to silence red jobs.

contracts.issue: Issue #506 P0 owner-reported Android sign-in disappearing CTA and app-wide jank
contracts.previous_behavior: On tap, the sign-in FilledButton was disabled by its request guard but no explicit disabled background/foreground was set; Material3 selected a low-contrast dark disabled surface so login and progress became visually empty. Sign-in also issued an extra OS-keystore hasRegisteredCredentials read before the already-required phone probe and real full-strength challenge, increasing serialized storage latency. After sign-out Yes the app waits for credential, SMS suspension, AI teardown and account authority writes without visible in-progress feedback, so users perceive a frozen signout.
contracts.approved_behavior: Keep the login CTA visibly white with dark high-contrast Arabic/English pending text and isolated green progress during disabled authentication; one accepted tap only, progress before secure work, no wrong-password success. Derive verifier existence from the same fail-closed probe, including after verified biometric recovery; preserve all recovery, old salt/hash migration, authenticated account save, SMS consent and Yes/No signout. Log only profile-mode stage durations without personal data. Do not equate source tests with physical Android whole-app latency success. After Yes show a real blocking Material progress veil, first paint before secure I/O, and unconditionally remove it on success/error; keep the original Yes/No confirmation and all fail-closed operations.
safety_invariants: Do not lower 600000-round PBKDF2 strength or move it to the Flutter rendering isolate.
Do not overwrite missing/foreign/malformed OS verifiers, fail open, or bypass biometric sign-in recovery.
Preserve verified SQLCipher/account finance authority and owner-bound SMS consent.
Sign-out remains Yes/No and must not erase financial records or credentials.
Only a real profile APK trace can prove no dropped frames, tap-to-feedback and login/logout completion on Android.
Always remove the signout progress overlay on failure as well as success; never begin another logout concurrently.

contracts.previous_behavior: Every new profile saved from the signed-out phone login set locked=true and presented a mandatory fingerprint even after a correct password. First-registration and process-restored profile also required biometric.
contracts.approved_behavior: Observe explicit sign-out before verified profile save, and only then skip the redundant immediate fingerprint on successful registered phone-password re-login. Preserve first registration and process-restored mandatory biometric, 60-second background idle gate, fail-closed old credential recovery and SQLCipher binding.
safety_invariants: Never let unverified phone/password bypass mandatory recovery biometric.
Never unlock an existing restored protected session without biometric.
Encrypted finance/account owner invariant is unchanged.

contracts.issue: Issue #509, owner requires eliminating three Android jank sources
contracts.previous_behavior: Home began four-page native SMS import immediately after first rendered frame; large verified ledger conversion was synchronous during Home/widget/SMS review; Android pauseAutoSmsForSignOut held queue mutex and committed preferences on main thread; login awaited SMS restart before navigation.
contracts.approved_behavior: Complete profile transition before native SMS restart; defer history work 900ms after Home interactive frame, yield between import cursor pages without dropping any; use existing 32-row async verified MoneyEntry mapper during startup, refresh, widget sync and reviewed SMS save; for large widget balance sums use compute(); execute native SMS suspension on SMS executor and deliver result on UI thread. Maintain owner-scoped encrypted records, full month scan, review-only SMS and verified ledger save.
safety_invariants: Never fake SMS consent or financial commits; queue remains review-only.
Android first-month scan must still cover start-of-install month with persistent cursor.
Must measure actual next APK frame timings before claiming lag-free.

contracts.issue: Issues #508 and #509: normal logout/relogin biometric and whole-app jank
contracts.previous_behavior: Normal logout then verified password login opened a second biometric gate; SMS resume could delay authenticated Home. Cold Home started heavy multi-page native SMS historical scanning alongside first render; finance save and widget reads could synchronously materialize thousands of records. Android SMS signout called encrypted queue suspension on main UI thread, stalling Flutter frames.
contracts.approved_behavior: After explicit logout, correct verified phone/password returns to an unlocked fresh Home session without extra biometrics, while restored sessions and >60-second background remain protected. Defer owner-checked SMS resume and bounded month-import work until after Home first frame, preserving review-only SMS and original consent. Build large verified ledger projections in bounded asynchronous batches after SQLCipher commit, with no partial/unverified balance or duplicate transaction. Suspend native SMS for signout on the history executor rather than Android main thread, return success only after safe suspension, fail closed on error.
safety_invariants: Preserve full-strength OS-bound password verifier and account-owner finance authority.
No automatic posting of SMS, no duplicate charge, no bypass of verified SQLCipher writes.
Keep native SMS signed-out suspension fail-closed and never expose financial data before authentication.
Do not claim smooth physical Android performance based on source tests alone.

Keep 600000 round password derivation, fail-closed credential recovery and verified SQLCipher financial state.
